start.speaker: kael
start.text: You did it. You actually brought him back alive.

daren_speaks.speaker: daren
daren_speaks.text: Kael...? I thought you'd given up on me.

kael_response.speaker: kael
kael_response.text: Never. But you're done running with bandits. I'll sort you out myself.

join.speaker: kael
join.text: A deal's a deal. You've earned my bow and my skills. Where you go, I go. — And a band this size wants a name on the contracts, or the guilds write whatever they please.

choices.text: Put a name to the band.
